reviews.review: I cannot recommend this game, for it is virtually unplayable. That is, multi player is very much broken. It is so badly optimized, you only get maybe 20-30 fps playing it, even with new nVidia GTX-980 you get low fps. And it doesn't matter if you lower the graphics, has no affect. Which is sad, 'cause this game has good potentials. I really wish it was playable, but it just isn't. Maybe if you have 10 GTX titan cards...
I can barely go into any server, and event then i get kicked from the very start without doing nothing. Host your own vanilla  servers, bohemia! That game is unplayable!

Watch some twitch before buying this game . Because its complicated and you may don't like it . I love it .

Wait for summer sale BTW .

Arma 3 is a relaxing and intense experience at the same time, you can go from walking down the street talking to people in Altis Life, and then an hour later you can be in the middle of a warzone with mortars going off left and right.

Do you want to play around with combat in the Warhammer 40k universe? there is a mod for that, do you want to dogfight in X-Wings from star wars? there is a mod for that. Do you want to reenact WWII operations? GUESS WHAT, there is a mod for that too!

This game is best experienced with a good group of friends, I and my friend have been playing antistatic lately and slowly taking over an island as insurgents, sabotaging enemy radio towers and stealing supplies, growing in strength, and taking the fight to them!

To me, this is what Arma is about, it's about the experience and the memories I’ve made with my friends, the amount of teamwork and coherence that we’ve developed through hours of playing together, how we overcome obstacles and difficult situations.

The learning curve is steep but it is o-so worth it, If you like military simulators or shooters and you wish they were just a little bit more in-depth or realistic, then this is absolutely the game for you. You can of course just play it as a normal shooter, not having to learn the in-depth controls at all!

I love this game and all of its janky problems
